headline: FIFA confirms Diallo, Tashima as Infantino's challengers at 2027 election
summary: FIFA named three candidatures. The electoral committee now decides on admission, and member associations are notified of admitted candidates by Feb 18, 2027.

headline: FIFA election: Who are Infantino's challengers, and will he be re-elected?
summary: Explainer on the field, the five-association nomination rule, and the debate over whether Infantino can serve a fourth term.

headline: Diallo to challenge Infantino after UEFA backing
UEFA backs France's Philippe Diallo to challenge Infantino in FIFA election
summary: UEFA said its 55 associations unanimously pledged support. The AFC has endorsed Infantino and CONCACAF has no stated position.

headline: AFC president Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa endorses Infantino
summary: Listed on the 77th Congress page. The AFC had earlier called for a review of FIFA leadership.

headline: New Zealand break ranks with Oceania as FIFA's Infantino divide grows
summary: New Zealand Football withdrew support. Six Arab federations backed Infantino on Aug 13. UEFA, the AFC and CONCACAF had called for a review.

headline: More European countries withdraw support for Infantino as pressure intensifies
summary: Finland, England, Wales and Serbia withdrew support and Sweden said it would oppose. Switzerland had not withdrawn.

headline: Africa and Asia back Infantino for unique fourth term as FIFA president
summary: CAF and the AFC announced support. Together with CONMEBOL they account for 110 of the 211 votes.
